1879064151.name: Cry of Vengeance

1879073495.name: Hobbit-silence
1879073495.desc: You can lie prone in complete silence, causing enemies to ignore you.

1879073751.name: Pounce
1879073751.desc: You leap at your target to distract it, interrupting actions it was performing.\n\n   <rgb=#00FFDD>Increased damage when attacking from behind</rgb>

1879089623.desc: A melee attack that heals the Morale of your Shield-brother.

1879160023.name: Harvestmath Pony
1879160023.desc: A pony from the Fall Festival.

1879213911.name: A Chink in the Armour (Tactical)

1879244247.name: All in the Wrist
1879244247.desc: Your skill allows you to sometimes accomplish truly remarkable feats on the field of battle; while many are in awe of what you do - it is all in the wrist.

1879255895.name: Launch a Green Firework
1879255895.desc: Launches a bright green firework for the Bree festival show.

1879291095.name: Challenge
1879291095.desc: Draws enemy threat away from your allies.

1879302615.name: Call to Arms: Archer (Footsoldier)
1879302615.desc: You enlist an Archer to assist you in battle.

1879315031.name: Call To Wild
1879315031.desc: Calling upon the beast within, your melee attacks do increased damage for a short period.

1879316055.desc: Consume remaining Wrath to deal a massive amount of damage. Places a mitigation buff on the Beorning. \n \n Damage is increased by 20% for every 20 Wrath you consume.

1879335639.name: Steed of the White City
1879335639.desc: A pony from the White City.

1879339351.name: Wildfowl Kite
1879339351.desc: Brings out a wildfowl kite for you to fly!

1879362263.name: White Hare
1879362263.desc: Brings out a white hare to keep you company.

1879401047.name: Hunting Steed
1879401047.desc: A steed with minimal trappings, perfect for navigating dense forests and jumping obstacles.

1879416151.name: One for All
1879416151.desc: Standing with allies bolsters everyone's resolve.\n\nReduces Incoming Damage by 10%. For each ally, the buff grants an additional 2% reduction, to a maximum of -20% based on the number of allies in your fellowship.

1879447383.name: Spotted Corgi
1879447383.desc: Brings out a friendly corgi to keep you company.

1879466327.name: Breach
1879466327.desc: A strong attack that opens an enemy to attack.\n\n <rgb=#00FFDD>Opens a combat response.</rgb>

1879486039.name: Call to Arms: Herald of Hope (Temamir Guard)
1879486039.desc: You enlist a Herald to carry your Banner of Hope into battle. This banner increases the mitigations of those around it.

1879497687.name: Sign of the Wild: Protection
1879497687.desc: Command your pet to use a defensive ability, prioritizing survival above all else.

1879508567.name: Obsidian Deep-claw Whelp
1879508567.desc: Summons an obsidian deep-claw whelp to accompany you on your travels.
